title: 하루 일과 낱말: 아침부터 밤까지
objective: By the end, you can use ten basic daily-routine words to say what you do in a normal day, such as when you get up, eat, work, and sleep.
summary: Learn ten basic words for talking about your daily routine, from getting up to going to bed.

task.title: TALK ABOUT YOUR DAY
task.line: Use the words on page 1 to choose, fill in, order, or write the Korean.

words.meaning: to wash; to wash up, to shower

words.exampleMeaning: In the evening, I eat dinner with a friend.
I go to work by nine.
I study Korean at the library.
I exercise in the park on weekends.

words.meaning: to go to bed, to sleep
words.exampleMeaning: I usually go to bed at twelve.

exercises: Choose the right word (일어나요 / 자요): 밤 열한 시예요. 이제 ____.
Choose the right word (점심 / 저녁): 낮 열두 시 반이에요. 친구하고 ____을 먹어요.
Fill in each blank with 씻어요, 운동해요, or 공부해요: ①내일 시험이 있어요. 오늘 밤에 ____. ②집에 왔어요. 손을 ____. ③건강이 중요해요. 그래서 매일 ____.
Put this day in order. Write the letters: ㄱ. 자요 ㄴ. 일어나요 ㄷ. 저녁을 먹어요 ㄹ. 아침을 먹어요
Answer in Korean with a full sentence. Use 여덟 시: 보통 몇 시에 회사에 가요?
Say it in Korean: I eat breakfast every day.
answers: ① 공부해요 ② 씻어요 ③ 운동해요
보통 여덟 시에 회사에 가요. (여덟 시에 회사에 가요.)
매일 아침을 먹어요. (저는 매일 아침을 먹어요.)
